remarks: Welcome to Homewood Drive, a beautifully reimagined residence nestled in the desirable foothill community of Altadena. Completely remodeled with thoughtful attention to detail, this home features a bright, refined interior, an updated kitchen and bathrooms, and stylish finishes throughout. Situated on an impressive lot of over 13,000 square feet, the expansive backyard is designed for Southern California living, featuring a swimming pool, tranquil koi pond, and generous space for entertaining, outdoor dining, and relaxation. Offering an exceptional combination of style, space, privacy, and outdoor living, this move-in-ready Altadena home is one you won’t want to miss.
